posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: You're not being ambitious enough with your AI. Run this reverse prompt: 'Based on what you know about me, what's the most ambitious question/prompt I could send you? One that could lead to a breakthrough or idea that can change my life? Nothing is too ambitious (as long as it's possible)'. Leverages full context for unknown unknowns.

posts.author: Andrej Karpathy
posts.text: Asked Claude to populate a Civilization-style game map with real US data. Opus 5.5 downloaded/parsed dozens of public sources (Census, BEA, EIA, NOAA…) → 25 km hex grid with GDP, jobs, power, airports, parks, etc. Deployed and fun to explore.

posts.author: Eric Zakariasson
posts.text: Grok Bot 1.3.0 is rolling out: smarter Slack bots, restock alerts and mobile Buy Now, automatic Teams setup with org controls, sideways X drafts carousel, Ashby connector, BCC on email drafts, and more soon. Changelog: x.ai/changelog/bot

posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: Speechless. Future of AI agents: Google Antigravity swarms spun up 7 Gemini Neon agents to tackle one problem in parallel (e.g. different system prompts/architectures), then orchestrator picks the winner. Use /swarm with Neon model.

posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: Open-sourced Herdr HUD: floating widget to manage/monitor all your AI coding agents while gaming (or any other full-screen app). Notifications + chat overlay. Works with free open-source Herdr CLI.

posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: Ran ChatGPT Astra 6.2 on my benchmark: 312.7/500, Fable 5.2 beat by 0.3. But Astra finished in 1/3 time, 1/3 price, 1/4 tokens. Efficiency matters.

posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: Testing GPT-6.2 Astra: good, better than Astra 6 at better cost, incredible at computer use, efficient. Not matching Fable 5.2 yet; test yourself against own workflows.
